prompt.v: A bag holds 9 yellow, 8 red, 2 blue, and 7 purple marbles. One is picked at random. What is the probability of not picking a yellow marble or a blue marble?

problems.text: complement: yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow red red red red red red red red blue blue purple purple purple purple purple purple purple; event is yellow or blue
problems.explain: P(a yellow marble or a blue marble) = 11/26, and the outcomes that are not a yellow marble or a blue marble are all the rest: 1 − 11/26 = 15/26. (Counting the 15 that are not wanted, out of 26, gives the same.) So 15/26.

prompt.v: A bag holds 9 yellow and 9 red marbles. One is picked at random. What is the probability of not picking a yellow marble?

problems.text: complement: yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow yellow red red red red red red red red red; event is yellow
problems.explain: P(a yellow marble) = 9/18 = 1/2, and the outcomes that are not a yellow marble are all the rest: 1 − 1/2 = 1/2. (Counting the 9 that are not wanted, out of 18, gives the same.) So 1/2.
